deviations.resolution: Template tier = verbatim EXCEPT universal identity-scrub
deviations.detail: IDENTITY split by hardness — HARD scrub-blocking literals (owner full-names, infra hostnames, DB names, vendors, client names) tokenize UNIVERSALLY (all tiers); display-identity literals (bare project name / org name / jurisdiction / regime labels) tokenize by POSITION (prose/comment, any file). Executables keep functional project-prefixed vocab (workflow/skill names); Plan 02 config-sources them. owner:/maintained_by: frontmatter tokenized to {{OWNER}} universally. A source-specific danger keyword was dropped from DANGER_RE so the tokenized regex stays valid ERE.
